rounds.text: Advance Metering Technology Ltd is trading at a deep asset discount, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.36x against a book value of ₹ 50.5 per share [E1]. This valuation is starkly divorced from reality when compared to the broader sector median price-to-book of 1.77x [E6]. Beneath the headline market capitalisation of ₹ 29.5 Cr [E2], the business is showing operational green shoots through recent sequential top-line expansion, specifically evidenced by sales being up quarter-over-quarter [E61]. Furthermore, recent price-led dynamics indicate that profit growth exceeds one-year price growth by 34%, signaling that the company is starting to outperform depressed market expectations [E52].
